기타.summary: 미국 하원이 피트 헤그세스 국방장관에 대한 탄핵 추진을 저지하면서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 공화당 지도부가 정치적 승리를 거뒀다는 평가가 나왔다. 다만 내년 1월 민주당이 의회 다수당을 차지하면 탄핵이 재추진되면서 정치적 공방이 다시 격화할 수 있다는 전망도 제기됐다. 10일(현지시간) AP통신과 영국 가디언 등에 따르면, 미 하원은 이날 헤그세스 장관에 대한 탄핵소추안을 법사위원회로 회부하는 동의안을 찬성 211표, 반대 204표로 가결했다. 이번 표결은 탄핵안 자체에 대한 찬반이 아니라 법사위 회부 여부를 결정하는 절차 표결이다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Achieves 80% Domestic Localization Rate for Robot Core Components
key_headlines.summary: The government is supporting development of sensors, actuators, and batteries for robotics, with plans to commercialize actuators by 2029 and humanoid batteries by 2030, investing 49.8 billion won in on-sensor AI technology.

key_headlines.title: Korean Exports Surge 368.7 Billion Dollars Year-over-Year with Semiconductors Driving 74% of Growth
key_headlines.summary: South Korea is on the verge of achieving record annual exports of 1 trillion dollars, with semiconductor exports nearly tripling from 139.2 billion to 413.4 billion dollars, driven by the global AI investment boom.

key_headlines.title: Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-il Announces 2027 Economic Growth Strategy Focusing on Potential Growth and Income Inequality
key_headlines.summary: The government will release its 2027 economic strategy in December, prioritizing increased potential growth rates and addressing income polarization, with economic forecasts increased from twice to three times annually for the first time in 32 years.

key_headlines.title: Stock Settlement System to Transition from T+2 to T+1 with Extended Testing Period
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock settlement cycle will be shortened from T+2 days to T+1 days, with over 6 months of testing before implementation and ongoing discussions with global investors about operational concerns.

key_headlines.title: U.S. October Consumer Inflation Exceeds Expectations, Raising December Fed Rate Hike Prospects
key_headlines.summary: U.S. consumer prices rose 0.4% month-over-month in October, surpassing forecasts and prompting Federal Reserve officials to signal possible 0.5 percentage point rate increases in December.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's exports are approaching the historic milestone of 1 trillion dollars annually, with semiconductors accounting for 74.3% of the year-over-year export increase. This unprecedented growth reflects the global AI investment supercycle and demonstrates Korea's strengthened competitive position in advanced chip manufacturing. The Deputy Prime Minister has unveiled a comprehensive 2027 economic growth strategy prioritizing increased potential growth rates and mitigation of income polarization. Additionally, the government is aggressively supporting robotics and battery technology localization, with 80% domestic sourcing targets for robot components and commercialization timelines extending through 2030.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is implementing the 2027 economic strategy with dual priorities on enhancing potential growth and addressing income inequality. Economic forecasts will be released three times annually instead of twice, marking the first major revision in 32 years to enable faster policy responses to domestic and international changes. The fuel tax reduction measures will be extended for an additional two months to support consumers. Meanwhile, U.S. inflation pressures are mounting, with October consumer prices exceeding expectations and prompting speculation of potential 0.5 percentage point Federal Reserve rate increases in December, which would significantly impact global economic conditions and Korean financial markets.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSDAQ surged approximately 4% while the KOSPI touched 5,300 during intraday trading, with the won-dollar exchange rate fluctuating around 1,330 won as export companies sold dollars despite U.S. rate hike concerns. Despite higher-than-expected U.S. inflation data weighing on global markets, foreign investors actively purchased Korean stocks, particularly in technology and semiconductor sectors. The New York markets closed lower amid inflation concerns and hawkish Federal Reserve signals, but Korean markets showed resilience with the KOSDAQ outperforming amid foreign investor buying. The transition to T+1 stock settlement from T+2 will require extensive system preparation and coordination with market participants.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung SDI and LG Energy Solution secured CES 2027 Innovation Awards for their battery technologies, with LG's Re.Pulse software diagnosing used EV batteries in 10 minutes. Samsung and Hyundai are expanding collaboration beyond electric vehicle batteries to include robotics and solid-state battery joint development targeting future mobility markets. BMW has selected Samsung SDI and LG Energy Solution as additional high-voltage battery cell suppliers for European and U.S. electric vehicles, strengthening Korean battery companies' global partnerships. Doosan is showcasing AI semiconductor materials at Germany's Electronica 2026 to capitalize on expanding AI data center demand and electric vehicle market opportunities.
sections.Real Estate: Democratic Party lawmakers are shifting housing policy focus from specific region price stabilization to stabilizing housing for non-homeowners and lower-income citizens, emphasizing housing pension utilization for comprehensive solutions. Investigators detected 354 fraudulent apartment subscription cases among 25,000 examined units, including false relocation schemes, fabricated dependent claims, and fake retirement claims by high-income earners attempting to circumvent regulations. Recent apartment transactions in Seoul's Gangdong and Dongjak districts have reached three-year highs, with prices continuing upward momentum in sought-after areas.
sections.International Economy: U.S. October consumer inflation rose 0.4% month-over-month, exceeding market expectations of 0.3% and prompting Federal Reserve officials to signal potential 0.5 percentage point rate increases in December. New York markets declined as investors confronted inflation concerns and hawkish Fed commentary from officials like Christopher Waller and Michelle Bowman regarding potential sharp rate increases. International focus has intensified on U.S. monetary policy developments and their cascading effects on global financial markets and currency valuations. The controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has exposed existing backdoor channels through which China circumvents U.S. semiconductor export controls via Southeast Asia.
sections.AI & Economy: The South Korean government announced plans to double AI investment to approximately 9 trillion won in 2027, capitalizing on global market uncertainties as opportunities to strengthen national competitiveness. Mashup Ventures has established a 25.9 billion won private fund focusing on pre-seed and seed stage AI and deep-tech companies, representing growing domestic venture capital commitment to early-stage innovation. Nexon and Krafton intensified competition for gaming industry leadership, both leveraging AI-driven development efficiency and new intellectual property releases to defend profitability amid market pressures. Tech officials emphasized that global AI market uncertainties present strategic opportunities for Korea to advance its AI and data center investment capabilities and secure competitive advantages.
sections.Others: South Korea ranked 10th globally in digital and AI competitiveness, rising eight positions year-over-year, with first-place ranking in R&D spending relative to GDP and eighth place in AI research publications. Samsung Asset Management expanded distributions on its KODEX 200 Target Weekly Covered Call ETF to reflect Samsung Electronics' and SK Hynix's special dividend allocations across November and December. Daesung Hi-Tech partnered with Israel's Blue Bird Aero Systems to establish military drone domestic production and export operations, showcasing joint ventures at the Korea Defense Expo 2026. The Korea Physical AI Association welcomed new corporate members, including AI operational data platform company AI to expand domestic and international industrial cooperation networks.
